page_title: QAT 0-2 ECU | Qatar v Ecuador 20/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Daniele Orsato has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Akram Afif (Qatar) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

90+5' Akram Afif (Qatar) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Qatar will take a corner.
90+5' Kevin Rodriguez (Ecuador) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
90+5' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Ecuador force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+3' Kevin Rodriguez (Ecuador) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Gustavo Alfaro has decided to make a change. Alan Franco (Ecuador) replaces Moises Caicedo.
90' Kevin Rodriguez (Ecuador) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Michael Estrada.
89' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) takes the corner which is cleared.
88' Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Ecuador force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' Mohammed Muntari (Qatar) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
83' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) takes the free kick, but it evades everyone in the box. The ball goes out of play and Qatar will have a goal kick.
82' Daniele Orsato couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mohammed Waad (Qatar) and blew his whistle. Ecuador have been awarded a free kick.
81' Saad Al Sheeb displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
79' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
78' Akram Afif (Qatar) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Orsato had an easy-decision to make.
77' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Enner Valencia (Ecuador) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Jose Adoni Cifuentes Charcopa.
75' Akram Afif (Qatar) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
73' A free kick into the box, taken by Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
72' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) brings an opponent down and Daniele Orsato interrupts the game. Ecuador are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
72' Felix Sanchez Bas prepares a substitution. Hasan Al Haydos is replaced by Mohammed Waad (Qatar).
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mohammed Muntari (Qatar) for Almoez Ali.
71' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat.

70' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Orsato no option but to blow his whistle. Ecuador are awarded a free kick.
70' Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
68' Gustavo Alfaro decides to make a substitution. Romario Ibarra will be replaced by Jeremy Sarmiento (Ecuador).
66' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
63' Almoez Ali (Qatar) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
63' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) is able to continue to play.
62' An accurate cross into the centre of the box from Abdelkarim Hassan gives Pedro Miguel (Qatar) a clear sight of goal, but he sends his headed effort narrowly wide of the left post.
61' Angelo Preciado (Ecuador) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' Felix Torres (Ecuador) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
59' Abdulaziz Hatem (Qatar) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
56' Jhegson Mendez (Ecuador) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Orsato didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

55' Romario Ibarra (Ecuador) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Saad Al Sheeb thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
53' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
52' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) tries to find Romario Ibarra, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
50' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Orsato starts the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Almoez Ali (Qatar), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.
45+3' Daniele Orsato blows the whistle, Homam Ahmed (Qatar) is penalised for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
43' The injury to Enner Valencia (Ecuador) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
40' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ecuador.
38' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Daniele Orsato shows the yellow card to Karim Boudiaf (Qatar) for a heavy challenge.
33' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.

31' 0 - 2 Goal – 0:2! Angelo Preciado sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Enner Valencia (Ecuador) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
29' Moises Caicedo (Ecuador) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
29' Romario Ibarra (Ecuador) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
27' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 0:1.
24' Daniele Orsato blows for a foul after Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
22' The foul by Almoez Ali (Qatar) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniele Orsato.
21' Michael Estrada (Ecuador) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' The game is interrupted now, Michael Estrada (Ecuador) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Michael Estrada (Ecuador) meets a cross from Pervis Estupinan, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
18' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Enner Valencia (Ecuador) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Saad Al Sheeb into the bottom right corner.
16' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) is going to take the penalty!
15' A yellow card for a tackle by Saad Al Sheeb (Qatar). Daniele Orsato doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

15' Saad Al Sheeb (Qatar) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement. No point in arguing there. Ecuador will take a penalty kick.
12' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Gonzalo Plata (Ecuador), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
11' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
10' Bassam Al Rawi (Qatar) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Ecuador.
8' Neat passing move from Ecuador in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Ecuador due to an offside in the build-up play.
4' The Ecuador players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Orsato makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
3' Enner Valencia (Ecuador) finds some space inside the box and powers his header past the goalkeeper, giving him no chance.
3' Pervis Estupinan (Ecuador) will take the free kick.
2' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Qatar will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Orsato.
